name: [HUGE UPD 🪨] Character Arena
desc:
🌀 Character Arena
Step into the action! Punch people to unlock new characters, each with unique abilities. Choose your fighter and show your skills in a fun and fast-paced arena.

✨ Weekly updates bring fresh content and improvements.
💬 Community feedback helps guide the game’s future.

🎮 Controls:
🖱️ Click – Punch
-- KEYBINDS :
1 – First Ability
2 – Second Ability
3 – Third Ability

Can you rise to the challenge and become a legend in the arena?

Credits to
Oliwier19500 (@Oliwier19500): Made most characters, made Animations and VFX
PrestonD3v (@hellothere_123456jj): Made some Characters, Fixed bugs, UI, Animations, Cutscenes

scripts.title: Auto punch
scripts.features: Auto punch player(add your nick name Instead of "Your nickname is here"
scripts.script:
while true do
    local args = {
        [1] = workspace:WaitForChild("Your nickname is here")
    }
    
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("PunchEvent"):FireServer(unpack(args))
    print("PunchEvent executed for Your nickname is here")
    
    wait(0)
end
